semanticReview.method: Seguimiento R33: relectura completa del artículo, reapertura de la revisión anterior, búsquedas distintas en fuentes institucionales/académicas gratuitas e inspección de los pasajes listados. Se conserva pendiente cuando no hay cobertura de todas las afirmaciones materiales.
findings: 自分 commonly has reflexive meaning and depends on a clause participant. No grammar source on reflexive antecedence was located in this follow-up.
It can be used for speaker self-reference in some registers/regions. The Bunka report notes self-reference 自分 among young speakers, but does not establish regional/professional distribution.
The article’s examples illustrate subject-oriented reflexivity and self-reference. No exact grammar/corpus locators were found for these examples.
It is not a universal synonym for “I”. The report’s mention of context and variable first-person forms is indirect support only.
